components.name: Introduction to Business and Consumer Studies
Research Methods in the Social Sciences
Business and Consumer Perspectives on Food Quality
components.note: Study food quality from business, consumer and food-science perspectives. General and laboratory safety requirements carry no credits and precede relevant practical work.

components.name: Quantitative and Qualitative Research Techniques in the Social Sciences
Food Innovation Research, a Gamma-Beta Approach
Financial Management in Agriculture
components.note: Selected restricted finance course: Financial Management in Agriculture. Corporate Financial Management is the other listed option.

components.name: Decision Science 2
components.note: Selected restricted methods course: Decision Science 2. The handbook recommends this option for a Business Economics or Operations Research thesis. Methods selection depends on the thesis topic and must be agreed with the thesis coordinator.

components.name: Strategic Change Management and Innovation
components.note: Selected restricted strategy course: Strategic Change Management and Innovation. Supply Chain Design and Planning is the other listed option.

components.name: BSc Thesis Business Studies
components.note: The current handbook requires 102 credits of compulsory and restricted study, including all first-year courses. The twelve credits include a one-credit Bachelor Assessment, which must be passed before the eleven-credit individual thesis. The module refers to a course guide for further required knowledge; its current chair-specific conditions remain unverified.

components.name: Open Electives or Minor
components.note: Thirty credits remain genuinely open for a minor, an individual minor or elective courses. The example does not invent a required minor or add the other specialisation’s courses.

routeSelection.basis: Generic target has two parallel majors with no general route. The current handbook lists Spec. A Business Studies before Consumer Studies; retain that neutral order independently of UCR fit.

audience.programmeDescription: Wageningen’s Business and Consumer Studies bachelor examines firms, consumers and the production and consumption of food and other products. This example follows the Business Studies major, with management, marketing, accounting, economics, research and quantitative decisions.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The published credit structure is shown while the current thesis guide’s preparatory requirements are verified. The prepared UCR comparison remains withheld pending that clarification.

curriculum.limitation: The listed components total 180 credits, but the current thesis guide’s remaining entry conditions have not been verified. This is a supported credit structure rather than a certified complete pathway.
